title: A Knight's Fury - Launched First Demo - Soup to Nuts AI Game
author: KnightFury2026
selftext:
Hey all  
  I have been working on getting a full AI game created, soup to nuts, with all workloads handled by AI, and I am sitting more as producer/director.  Its been a lot of time, and there were several times I had to handle things manually, but the amount of time saving has been really great.  Also iterations to work on gameplay has been so much quicker and faster, it has helped a lot.

Anyway, I finally get a demo out for my upcoming game, A Knight's Fury.  I wanted to post here and let everyone know.  

Quick Notes:

AI used : ChatGPT and Claude Code, MCP server connection through VSCode to Unity 6 (havent used CLI yet). 

Steam : [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4684610/A\_Knights\_Fury\_\_The\_Vaults\_of\_Venom/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4684610/A_Knights_Fury__The_Vaults_of_Venom/)

I got a discord for the studio, and plan to release more games in varying genres in the future.  
Discord: [https://discord.gg/eWYTVsZQd](https://discord.gg/eWYTVsZQd)

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: How are your wishlists going? I'm getting my own steam page ready to release my AI-built game. Would love to hear your experience in getting wishlists and people interested in the game

replies.author: KnightFury2026
replies.body:
It's going.  I don't really have anything to compare it to, so I don't know what a "non-ai" game would get like this in comparison, but the AI hate is real.  
 I am mostly just posting on here and X while trying to hit up some forums.  The wishlists are no where near where I want them, but I am hoping the Demo + Steam Next Fest in Oct can help.

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: Aren't you disallowed from entering next fest if you already released the demo?

replies.author: KnightFury2026
replies.body: Not to my knowledge, I thought you just needed to have a demo available before the cut off time.  I think you are limited to 1 next fest per game though, but I believe you need to just have the demo and opt in, but I havent dont this yet, so I am not sure.
